schema: VietlishCorpusEntry (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts) - { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
author: A2 (Content Factory wave 13)
definition: Thirteenth-wave candidate Vietnamese-L1 interference items for human review before promotion into VIETLISH_CORPUS. Focus areas: workplace requests, shopping/market register, healthcare visits, travel booking, family obligation phrases, study habits, phone etiquette, polite refusal, quantity/mass-noun errors, and aspect-marking calques.
dedupedAgainst: A2 local check against live VIETLISH_CORPUS plus pending waves 1-12, case-insensitive vietlish matching.

entries.vietlish: can you open the aircon a bit
entries.natural: can you turn on the air conditioning a bit
entries.sourcePattern: mở máy lạnh -> open used for turning on appliances
entries.context: It is so hot in here, can you open the aircon a bit?

entries.vietlish: I want to close the fan
entries.natural: I want to turn off the fan
entries.sourcePattern: tắt quạt -> close used for turning off appliances
entries.context: I am cold now, I want to close the fan.

entries.vietlish: she drink medicine every morning
entries.natural: she takes medicine every morning
entries.sourcePattern: uống thuốc -> uống is drink, applied to medicine
entries.context: The doctor told her to rest and she drink medicine every morning.

entries.vietlish: I need to eat vitamin C
entries.natural: I need to take vitamin C
entries.sourcePattern: ăn vitamin -> ăn is eat, applied to supplements
entries.context: My throat hurts, I think I need to eat vitamin C.

entries.vietlish: please write your name into this form
entries.natural: please write your name on this form
entries.sourcePattern: điền vào mẫu -> vào means into, preposition transfer
entries.context: Before you see the doctor, please write your name into this form.

entries.vietlish: do you accept visa card here
entries.natural: do you accept credit cards here
entries.sourcePattern: thẻ visa -> visa card used as generic for credit card
entries.context: I do not have cash with me, do you accept visa card here?

entries.vietlish: I want to withdraw money from the machine
entries.natural: I want to withdraw money from the ATM
entries.sourcePattern: rút tiền ở máy -> machine used for ATM
entries.context: Can you tell me if there is a bank around here? I want to withdraw money from the machine.

entries.vietlish: I need to top up my phone
entries.natural: I need to add credit to my phone
entries.sourcePattern: nạp tiền điện thoại -> top up is a direct translation that may confuse some listeners
entries.context: My phone is about to run out, I need to top up my phone.

entries.vietlish: she make up her face every morning
entries.natural: she puts on makeup every morning
entries.sourcePattern: trang điểm -> make up face used as verb phrase
entries.context: She takes at least thirty minutes, she make up her face every morning.

entries.vietlish: I want to do a haircut
entries.natural: I want to get a haircut
entries.sourcePattern: cắt tóc -> do instead of get for services
entries.context: My hair is too long now, I want to do a haircut this weekend.

entries.vietlish: can you fix my bicycle
entries.natural: can you repair my bicycle
entries.sourcePattern: sửa xe đạp -> fix is informal; repair is standard in Vietnamese service contexts
entries.context: The chain came off, can you fix my bicycle for me please?

entries.vietlish: I need to wash my clothes today
entries.natural: I need to do my laundry today
entries.sourcePattern: giặt quần áo -> wash clothes instead of do laundry
entries.context: I have nothing left to wear, I need to wash my clothes today.

entries.vietlish: let me take you to eat
entries.natural: let me take you out to dinner
entries.sourcePattern: mời bạn đi ăn -> take to eat, no out or meal specification
entries.context: You helped me a lot this week, let me take you to eat tonight.

entries.vietlish: I will go eat with my colleague
entries.natural: I will go out for lunch with my colleague
entries.sourcePattern: đi ăn với đồng nghiệp -> go eat, no specific meal or out
entries.context: I am not free at noon, I will go eat with my colleague.

entries.vietlish: she play guitar very well
entries.natural: she plays the guitar very well
entries.sourcePattern: chơi đàn guitar giỏi -> article the dropped before instrument, third-person -s dropped
entries.context: At the school concert she play guitar very well and everyone clapped.

entries.vietlish: I am learning to play piano
entries.natural: I am learning to play the piano
entries.sourcePattern: học chơi đàn piano -> article the dropped before musical instrument
entries.context: I started lessons last month, I am learning to play piano.

entries.vietlish: I cook rice in the morning for the family
entries.natural: I make rice in the morning for the family
entries.sourcePattern: nấu cơm -> nấu is cook, cơm is cooked rice; cook rice is acceptable but make rice is more natural
entries.context: I wake up early every day, I cook rice in the morning for the family.

entries.vietlish: she is taking care the baby
entries.natural: she is taking care of the baby
entries.sourcePattern: chăm sóc em bé -> take care without of, preposition dropped
entries.context: She cannot come to the event, she is taking care the baby at home.

entries.vietlish: I will pick up you at the airport
entries.natural: I will pick you up at the airport
entries.sourcePattern: đón bạn ở sân bay -> particle placement error in phrasal verb
entries.context: Do not worry about transport, I will pick up you at the airport.

entries.vietlish: he set up a new business
entries.natural: he started a new business
entries.sourcePattern: thành lập doanh nghiệp -> set up overused for start/establish
entries.context: After leaving his job he set up a new business in the food industry.

entries.vietlish: can you help me to find the way
entries.natural: can you help me find the way
entries.sourcePattern: giúp tôi tìm đường -> to-infinitive added after help unnecessarily
entries.context: I am lost, can you help me to find the way to the market?

entries.vietlish: I need to translate this letter to English
entries.natural: I need to translate this letter into English
entries.sourcePattern: dịch bức thư này sang tiếng Anh -> to used instead of into for translation
entries.context: This is a Vietnamese document, I need to translate this letter to English.

entries.vietlish: she applied for a scholarship
entries.natural: she applied for a scholarship
entries.sourcePattern: nộp đơn xin học bổng -> correct but overused form even when applied is not the intended verb (e.g. submitted)
entries.context: She worked hard all semester and she applied for a scholarship at the end of the year.

entries.vietlish: I graduated university in 2022
entries.natural: I graduated from university in 2022
entries.sourcePattern: tốt nghiệp đại học -> graduated without from
entries.context: I graduated university in 2022 and started working right away.

entries.vietlish: I will try to save money for the trip
entries.natural: I am trying to save up for the trip
entries.sourcePattern: tiết kiệm tiền cho chuyến đi -> try instead of be trying, for the trip without up
entries.context: I really want to go but I will try to save money for the trip.

entries.vietlish: she is good in cooking
entries.natural: she is good at cooking
entries.sourcePattern: giỏi nấu ăn -> good in instead of good at
entries.context: She is good in cooking, especially traditional Vietnamese dishes.

entries.vietlish: he is weak in mathematics
entries.natural: he is weak at mathematics
entries.sourcePattern: yếu toán -> weak in instead of weak at
entries.context: He needs extra tutoring because he is weak in mathematics.

entries.vietlish: I am interested to learn more
entries.natural: I am interested in learning more
entries.sourcePattern: tôi quan tâm đến -> interested to instead of interested in + gerund
entries.context: After the workshop I am interested to learn more about the topic.

entries.vietlish: she is experienced in handle customer complaints
entries.natural: she is experienced in handling customer complaints
entries.sourcePattern: có kinh nghiệm xử lý khiếu nại -> in + bare verb instead of gerund
entries.context: She is experienced in handle customer complaints from her previous job.

entries.vietlish: I am satisfied of the result
entries.natural: I am satisfied with the result
entries.sourcePattern: hài lòng với kết quả -> satisfied of instead of satisfied with
entries.context: After so much effort, I am satisfied of the result we achieved.

entries.vietlish: she is angry of him
entries.natural: she is angry with him
entries.sourcePattern: tức giận với anh ấy -> angry of instead of angry with
entries.context: She has not spoken to him for three days, she is angry of him.

entries.vietlish: I am bored of studying
entries.natural: I am tired of studying
entries.sourcePattern: chán học -> bored of for tired of/fed up with
entries.context: I have been at it for five hours, I am bored of studying.

entries.vietlish: she is scared of present in front of people
entries.natural: she is scared of presenting in front of people
entries.sourcePattern: sợ trình bày trước đám đông -> scared of + bare verb instead of gerund
entries.context: Public speaking is hard for her, she is scared of present in front of people.

entries.vietlish: I am proud of my country
entries.natural: I am proud of my country
entries.sourcePattern: tự hào về đất nước mình -> correct but sometimes produced with about instead of of
entries.context: When I travel abroad I am proud of my country and its culture.

entries.vietlish: he is famous of his cooking skills
entries.natural: he is famous for his cooking skills
entries.sourcePattern: nổi tiếng với/vì kỹ năng nấu ăn -> famous of instead of famous for
entries.context: He is famous of his cooking skills in our neighbourhood.

entries.vietlish: she is responsible of the project
entries.natural: she is responsible for the project
entries.sourcePattern: chịu trách nhiệm về dự án -> responsible of instead of responsible for
entries.context: She is responsible of the project so you should talk to her.

entries.vietlish: I am tired with this situation
entries.natural: I am tired of this situation
entries.sourcePattern: mệt mỏi với tình trạng này -> tired with instead of tired of
entries.context: It keeps getting worse, I am tired with this situation.

entries.vietlish: she is afraid of fly on a plane
entries.natural: she is afraid of flying on a plane
entries.sourcePattern: sợ bay máy bay -> afraid of + bare verb instead of gerund
entries.context: She always takes the train because she is afraid of fly on a plane.

entries.vietlish: I am curious of what he said
entries.natural: I am curious about what he said
entries.sourcePattern: tò mò về điều anh ấy nói -> curious of instead of curious about
entries.context: I could not hear the conversation, I am curious of what he said.

entries.vietlish: he complain about the noise all the time
entries.natural: he complains about the noise all the time
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy than phiền về tiếng ồn -> third-person -s dropped
entries.context: He is a difficult neighbour, he complain about the noise all the time.

entries.vietlish: she concentrate in her studies
entries.natural: she concentrates on her studies
entries.sourcePattern: tập trung vào việc học -> concentrate in instead of concentrate on, -s dropped
entries.context: She puts her phone away and she concentrate in her studies every evening.

entries.vietlish: I specialize in teach English to children
entries.natural: I specialise in teaching English to children
entries.sourcePattern: chuyên dạy tiếng Anh cho trẻ em -> specialise in + bare verb instead of gerund
entries.context: When parents ask what I do, I say I specialize in teach English to children.

entries.vietlish: this building consist of ten floor
entries.natural: this building consists of ten floors
entries.sourcePattern: tòa nhà gồm mười tầng -> consist of without -s on verb, floor not pluralised
entries.context: This building consist of ten floor and each floor has eight apartments.

entries.vietlish: can I pay by transfer
entries.natural: can I pay by bank transfer
entries.sourcePattern: chuyển khoản -> pay by transfer, bank omitted
entries.context: I do not have cash today, can I pay by transfer?

entries.vietlish: she got a good score in the test
entries.natural: she scored well on the test
entries.sourcePattern: đạt điểm cao trong bài thi -> got a good score in instead of scored well on
entries.context: She studied hard and she got a good score in the test.

entries.vietlish: I do exercise in the park every morning
entries.natural: I exercise in the park every morning
entries.sourcePattern: tập thể dục -> do exercise instead of exercise as intransitive verb
entries.context: I do exercise in the park every morning to stay healthy.

entries.vietlish: she passed the driving exam in first try
entries.natural: she passed the driving test on the first try
entries.sourcePattern: thi lái xe lần đầu đỗ -> exam instead of test, in instead of on
entries.context: She is very capable, she passed the driving exam in first try.

entries.vietlish: I took a nap in the afternoon
entries.natural: I took a nap in the afternoon
entries.sourcePattern: ngủ trưa -> correct production, common in Vietnamese daily talk
entries.context: I was tired after lunch so I took a nap in the afternoon.

entries.vietlish: he made a mistake in the calculation
entries.natural: he made an error in the calculation
entries.sourcePattern: phạm sai lầm -> mistake in instead of error in in formal writing
entries.context: Please review it again, he made a mistake in the calculation.

entries.vietlish: I already paid the bill yesterday
entries.natural: I paid the bill yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: đã trả tiền -> đã is past completive, mirrored as already
entries.context: You don't need to pay again, I already paid the bill yesterday.

entries.vietlish: he already left the office
entries.natural: he left the office
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy đã rời -> đã completive rendered as already in simple past
entries.context: If you want to meet him, you are too late, he already left the office.

entries.vietlish: I already finish my homework
entries.natural: I have already finished my homework
entries.sourcePattern: tôi xong bài rồi -> completive rồi + no present perfect
entries.context: Mom, can I play outside now? I already finish my homework.

entries.vietlish: she just come back from Hanoi
entries.natural: she just came back from Hanoi
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy vừa về -> vừa is just, past tense dropped
entries.context: She just come back from Hanoi so she is very tired.

entries.vietlish: I just eat so I am full
entries.natural: I just ate so I am full
entries.sourcePattern: tôi vừa ăn -> vừa aspect marker, past tense dropped
entries.context: No thank you, I just eat so I am full.

entries.vietlish: they are husband and wife already three year
entries.natural: they have been husband and wife for three years
entries.sourcePattern: ba năm rồi -> duration with rồi, no present perfect
entries.context: They are husband and wife already three year but still no children.

entries.vietlish: I study here already two semester
entries.natural: I have been studying here for two semesters
entries.sourcePattern: học ở đây được hai kỳ rồi -> already for duration, no present perfect
entries.context: I study here already two semester and I like it very much.

entries.vietlish: the price go up last month
entries.natural: the price went up last month
entries.sourcePattern: giá tăng -> no past tense inflection on go
entries.context: I bought more rice because the price go up last month.

entries.vietlish: the package not arrive yet
entries.natural: the package has not arrived yet
entries.sourcePattern: kiện hàng chưa đến -> chưa is not yet, no present perfect
entries.context: I am still waiting, the package not arrive yet.

entries.vietlish: I not receive the email
entries.natural: I have not received the email
entries.sourcePattern: tôi chưa nhận được email -> chưa negation without present perfect
entries.context: Can you send it again? I not receive the email.

entries.vietlish: they not contact me since last week
entries.natural: they have not contacted me since last week
entries.sourcePattern: họ không liên lạc từ tuần trước -> no present perfect for since-duration
entries.context: I am worried, they not contact me since last week.

entries.vietlish: she already know about this problem
entries.natural: she already knows about this problem
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy biết rồi -> third person singular -s dropped
entries.context: No need to explain again, she already know about this problem.

entries.vietlish: he still not understand the rule
entries.natural: he still does not understand the rule
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy vẫn không hiểu -> auxiliary does dropped
entries.context: The teacher explained twice but he still not understand the rule.

entries.vietlish: I have some homeworks to finish
entries.natural: I have some homework to finish
entries.sourcePattern: bài tập -> homework treated as countable
entries.context: I cannot go out tonight, I have some homeworks to finish.

entries.vietlish: she gave me two informations
entries.natural: she gave me two pieces of information
entries.sourcePattern: thông tin -> information pluralized with number
entries.context: She gave me two informations about the new policy.

entries.vietlish: I have a lot of works to do
entries.natural: I have a lot of work to do
entries.sourcePattern: công việc -> work pluralized
entries.context: I cannot meet you today, I have a lot of works to do.

entries.vietlish: please give me a feedback
entries.natural: please give me some feedback
entries.sourcePattern: phản hồi -> feedback treated as countable with article
entries.context: After you read my report, please give me a feedback.

entries.vietlish: I need buy new equipments for the lab
entries.natural: I need to buy new equipment for the lab
entries.sourcePattern: thiết bị -> equipment pluralized, to-infinitive marker dropped
entries.context: I need buy new equipments for the lab this semester.

entries.vietlish: we have too many traffics today
entries.natural: there is too much traffic today
entries.sourcePattern: nhiều xe cộ -> traffic pluralized, existential there is dropped
entries.context: Why are you late? We have too many traffics today on the highway.

entries.vietlish: this room has no enough spaces
entries.natural: this room does not have enough space
entries.sourcePattern: không đủ chỗ -> space pluralized, do-support dropped
entries.context: We cannot put more chairs, this room has no enough spaces.

entries.vietlish: I have three luggages for the trip
entries.natural: I have three pieces of luggage for the trip
entries.sourcePattern: hành lý -> luggage pluralized with number
entries.context: The airline only allows one bag but I have three luggages for the trip.

entries.vietlish: I want to research about this topic
entries.natural: I want to research this topic
entries.sourcePattern: nghiên cứu về -> về is about, added as preposition after research
entries.context: For my thesis I want to research about this topic in detail.

entries.vietlish: can we discuss about the schedule
entries.natural: can we discuss the schedule
entries.sourcePattern: thảo luận về -> về is about, added unnecessarily after discuss
entries.context: Before we start, can we discuss about the schedule for today?

entries.vietlish: I will marry with her next year
entries.natural: I will marry her next year
entries.sourcePattern: cưới với -> với is with, transferred to marry
entries.context: I already proposed, I will marry with her next year.

entries.vietlish: he contact with me last night
entries.natural: he contacted me last night
entries.sourcePattern: liên lạc với -> với transferred after contact + past tense dropped
entries.context: He contact with me last night to say he is coming.

entries.vietlish: she meet with the doctor this morning
entries.natural: she met with the doctor this morning
entries.sourcePattern: gặp bác sĩ -> past tense dropped
entries.context: She feel better now, she meet with the doctor this morning.

entries.vietlish: the shop close at nine
entries.natural: the shop closes at nine
entries.sourcePattern: cửa hàng đóng cửa -> third person -s dropped
entries.context: Hurry up, the shop close at nine and it is already eight thirty.

entries.vietlish: my phone not have signal here
entries.natural: my phone does not have signal here
entries.sourcePattern: điện thoại không có sóng -> do-support dropped
entries.context: I could not call you, my phone not have signal here.

entries.vietlish: today I very busy
entries.natural: today I am very busy
entries.sourcePattern: hôm nay tôi bận -> copula am dropped
entries.context: Sorry I cannot help you today, today I very busy.

entries.vietlish: she very good at English
entries.natural: she is very good at English
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy rất giỏi tiếng Anh -> copula is dropped
entries.context: You should ask her, she very good at English.

entries.vietlish: this food very spicy
entries.natural: this food is very spicy
entries.sourcePattern: món này cay lắm -> copula dropped before adjective
entries.context: Be careful, this food very spicy, you may not be used to it.

entries.vietlish: that bag not expensive
entries.natural: that bag is not expensive
entries.sourcePattern: cái túi đó không đắt -> copula dropped in negation
entries.context: You should buy it, that bag not expensive and the quality is good.

entries.vietlish: my father not at home
entries.natural: my father is not at home
entries.sourcePattern: bố tôi không ở nhà -> copula dropped in locative
entries.context: You can call back later, my father not at home right now.

entries.vietlish: the weather very nice today
entries.natural: the weather is very nice today
entries.sourcePattern: thời tiết đẹp lắm -> copula dropped with adjective predicate
entries.context: Let us go for a walk, the weather very nice today.

entries.vietlish: I boring in class
entries.natural: I am bored in class
entries.sourcePattern: tôi chán -> boring/bored confusion, copula dropped
entries.context: The teacher talks too long, I boring in class.

entries.vietlish: the class begin at eight
entries.natural: the class begins at eight
entries.sourcePattern: lớp học bắt đầu lúc tám giờ -> third-person -s dropped
entries.context: Hurry up and get dressed, the class begin at eight and it is already quarter to.

entries.vietlish: this medicine taste bitter
entries.natural: this medicine tastes bitter
entries.sourcePattern: thuốc này đắng -> third-person -s dropped on taste
entries.context: Mix it with some honey because this medicine taste bitter.

entries.vietlish: the river very deep here
entries.natural: the river is very deep here
entries.sourcePattern: con sông rất sâu -> copula dropped before adjective
entries.context: Be careful, the river very deep here, do not swim alone.

entries.vietlish: the road very slippery after rain
entries.natural: the road is very slippery after rain
entries.sourcePattern: đường trơn lắm sau mưa -> copula dropped before adjective
entries.context: Ride slowly, the road very slippery after rain.

entries.vietlish: the queue very long today
entries.natural: the queue is very long today
entries.sourcePattern: hàng đợi dài lắm -> copula dropped before adjective
entries.context: We may have to wait an hour, the queue very long today at the government office.

entries.vietlish: my bag very heavy
entries.natural: my bag is very heavy
entries.sourcePattern: túi nặng lắm -> copula dropped before adjective
entries.context: Can you help me carry this? My bag very heavy today.

entries.vietlish: the exam very difficult
entries.natural: the exam was very difficult
entries.sourcePattern: bài thi khó lắm -> copula dropped, past tense not marked
entries.context: Everyone complained that the exam very difficult this semester.

entries.vietlish: the class very interesting
entries.natural: the class was very interesting
entries.sourcePattern: lớp học thú vị lắm -> copula + past dropped
entries.context: I am glad I signed up, the class very interesting and the teacher explains well.

entries.vietlish: the meeting cancel
entries.natural: the meeting was cancelled
entries.sourcePattern: cuộc họp bị hủy -> passive without was + past participled
entries.context: You do not need to come in today, the meeting cancel.

entries.vietlish: the window broke
entries.natural: the window was broken
entries.sourcePattern: cửa sổ bị vỡ -> passive without was, or past without auxiliary
entries.context: There was a storm last night and the window broke.

entries.vietlish: my phone charge full now
entries.natural: my phone is fully charged now
entries.sourcePattern: điện thoại sạc đầy rồi -> charge full used as predicate adjective phrase
entries.context: You can have your charger back, my phone charge full now.

entries.vietlish: the door lock already
entries.natural: the door is already locked
entries.sourcePattern: cửa khóa rồi -> lock as adjective without be and proper past participle
entries.context: Do not worry, the door lock already before we left.

entries.vietlish: the ticket sell out
entries.natural: the tickets are sold out
entries.sourcePattern: vé bán hết rồi -> sell out without be and plural marking
entries.context: We waited too long, the ticket sell out.

entries.vietlish: he very tired after the journey
entries.natural: he is very tired after the journey
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy rất mệt -> copula dropped before adjective
entries.context: Let him rest, he very tired after the journey.

entries.vietlish: I hungry already
entries.natural: I am already hungry
entries.sourcePattern: tôi đói rồi -> adjective predicate without copula, already at end
entries.context: Can we order now? I hungry already.

entries.vietlish: she hot because of the weather
entries.natural: she is hot because of the weather
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy nóng vì thời tiết -> copula dropped before adjective
entries.context: She keeps fanning herself, she hot because of the weather.

entries.vietlish: I really want go there
entries.natural: I really want to go there
entries.sourcePattern: tôi thật sự muốn đến đó -> to-infinitive marker dropped after want
entries.context: I saw the photos on Instagram, I really want go there someday.

entries.vietlish: she plan study medicine
entries.natural: she plans to study medicine
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy dự định học y -> third-person -s dropped + to-infinitive dropped
entries.context: She is very smart, she plan study medicine at the national university.

entries.vietlish: I forget bring my wallet
entries.natural: I forgot to bring my wallet
entries.sourcePattern: tôi quên mang ví -> to-infinitive dropped after forget, past tense dropped
entries.context: Can you pay for now? I forget bring my wallet today.

entries.vietlish: she avoid meet him at work
entries.natural: she avoids meeting him at work
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy tránh gặp anh ta -> third-person -s dropped, meet instead of meeting after avoid
entries.context: They had an argument and now she avoid meet him at work.

entries.vietlish: I finish eat already
entries.natural: I have already finished eating
entries.sourcePattern: tôi ăn xong rồi -> finish eat without to/ing, present perfect dropped
entries.context: You can clear my plate, I finish eat already.

entries.vietlish: he enjoy cook for his family
entries.natural: he enjoys cooking for his family
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy thích nấu ăn -> third-person -s dropped, cook instead of cooking after enjoy
entries.context: On weekends he enjoy cook for his family as a way to relax.

entries.vietlish: I consider change my job
entries.natural: I am considering changing my job
entries.sourcePattern: tôi đang cân nhắc đổi việc -> consider + bare infinitive, progressive dropped
entries.context: The atmosphere there is very bad, I consider change my job.

entries.vietlish: they discuss go to Da Lat this weekend
entries.natural: they discussed going to Da Lat this weekend
entries.sourcePattern: họ bàn bạc đi Đà Lạt -> discuss + bare verb, past tense dropped
entries.context: They are excited, they discuss go to Da Lat this weekend.

entries.vietlish: I practice speak English every day
entries.natural: I practice speaking English every day
entries.sourcePattern: tôi luyện nói tiếng Anh mỗi ngày -> practice + bare verb instead of gerund
entries.context: My English gets better, I practice speak English every day with my tutor.

entries.vietlish: she keep complain about the same thing
entries.natural: she keeps complaining about the same thing
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy cứ phàn nàn -> third-person -s dropped, gerund form dropped
entries.context: It is getting annoying, she keep complain about the same thing every day.

entries.vietlish: he start understand the lesson
entries.natural: he is starting to understand the lesson
entries.sourcePattern: anh ấy bắt đầu hiểu bài -> start + bare verb, progressive dropped
entries.context: The tutoring is helping, he start understand the lesson more clearly.

entries.vietlish: I need print this document
entries.natural: I need to print this document
entries.sourcePattern: tôi cần in tài liệu này -> to-infinitive after need dropped
entries.context: Before the meeting, I need print this document for everyone.

entries.vietlish: you should listen the teacher
entries.natural: you should listen to the teacher
entries.sourcePattern: bạn nên nghe giáo viên -> preposition to dropped after listen
entries.context: Stop talking and you should listen the teacher explain the lesson.

entries.vietlish: I depend my parents for money
entries.natural: I depend on my parents for money
entries.sourcePattern: tôi phụ thuộc vào bố mẹ -> preposition on dropped after depend
entries.context: I am still a student so I depend my parents for money.

entries.vietlish: the movie make me cry
entries.natural: the movie made me cry
entries.sourcePattern: bộ phim làm tôi khóc -> make causative without past tense
entries.context: I did not expect it to be so sad, the movie make me cry.

entries.vietlish: the news make me happy
entries.natural: the news made me happy
entries.sourcePattern: tin tức làm tôi vui -> make causative without past tense
entries.context: I heard you are getting married, the news make me happy.

entries.vietlish: her smile make everyone happy
entries.natural: her smile makes everyone happy
entries.sourcePattern: nụ cười của cô ấy làm mọi người vui -> make causative, third-person -s dropped
entries.context: She is so warm, her smile make everyone happy.

entries.vietlish: the smell of the food make me hungry
entries.natural: the smell of the food makes me hungry
entries.sourcePattern: mùi thức ăn làm tôi đói -> make causative, third-person -s dropped
entries.context: I walk past the market and the smell of the food make me hungry.

entries.vietlish: her words hurt me a lot
entries.natural: her words hurt me a lot
entries.sourcePattern: lời nói của cô ấy làm tôi đau lòng -> correct but sometimes produced with make hurt
entries.context: I did not say anything back but her words hurt me a lot.

entries.vietlish: do you have any program tonight
entries.natural: do you have any plans tonight
entries.sourcePattern: có chương trình gì không -> chương trình is program, used for plans/events
entries.context: Do you have any program tonight or are you free?

entries.vietlish: I want to study abroad to open my vision
entries.natural: I want to study abroad to broaden my horizons
entries.sourcePattern: mở mang tầm nhìn -> open vision, literal for broaden horizons
entries.context: I want to study abroad to open my vision and experience new things.

entries.vietlish: she has a very big heart
entries.natural: she is very kind-hearted
entries.sourcePattern: có tâm lớn -> big heart used for generous/kind personality
entries.context: She always helps people, she has a very big heart.

entries.vietlish: he is a hard person
entries.natural: he is a strict person
entries.sourcePattern: người khó -> khó is hard/difficult, applied to strictness
entries.context: Be careful what you say, he is a hard person to please.

entries.vietlish: my salary is not enough to live
entries.natural: my salary is not enough to live on
entries.sourcePattern: không đủ sống -> sống is to live, preposition on dropped
entries.context: This city is too expensive, my salary is not enough to live.

entries.vietlish: can you support me to carry this box
entries.natural: can you help me carry this box
entries.sourcePattern: hỗ trợ -> hỗ trợ means support/assist but used where help is natural
entries.context: This box is very heavy, can you support me to carry this box?

entries.vietlish: she is very sensitive in that area
entries.natural: she is very knowledgeable in that area
entries.sourcePattern: nhạy bén -> nhạy can mean sensitive or sharp/astute in context
entries.context: Ask her about the policy, she is very sensitive in that area.

entries.vietlish: I just graduated and I am finding a job
entries.natural: I just graduated and I am looking for a job
entries.sourcePattern: tìm việc -> tìm is find, used for looking for
entries.context: I just graduated and I am finding a job in the IT sector.

entries.vietlish: this shop sells clothes with cheap price
entries.natural: this shop sells clothes at a low price
entries.sourcePattern: giá rẻ -> rẻ is cheap, with price calques giá
entries.context: You should go there, this shop sells clothes with cheap price.

entries.vietlish: the weather is quite cold today, right
entries.natural: the weather is quite cold today, isn't it
entries.sourcePattern: phải không -> phải không is right/isn't it, rendered as right
entries.context: The weather is quite cold today, right? Did you bring a jacket?

entries.vietlish: I am curious why she act like that
entries.natural: I am curious about why she acted like that
entries.sourcePattern: tôi tò mò -> curious followed by why without about, past dropped
entries.context: She left without saying goodbye, I am curious why she act like that.

entries.vietlish: can I lend your pen for a moment
entries.natural: can I borrow your pen for a moment
entries.sourcePattern: mượn -> mượn is borrow but learners say lend
entries.context: I forgot mine, can I lend your pen for a moment?

entries.vietlish: I will borrow you money when I get paid
entries.natural: I will lend you money when I get paid
entries.sourcePattern: cho mượn -> cho is give/lend, mượn borrow, direction confused
entries.context: Don't worry, I will borrow you money when I get paid.

entries.vietlish: her cooking is very delicious
entries.natural: her cooking is delicious
entries.sourcePattern: nấu ăn ngon -> very delicious is redundant intensifier pattern
entries.context: We always look forward to dinner, her cooking is very delicious.

entries.vietlish: I am not confident about my English communication
entries.natural: I am not confident in my English communication
entries.sourcePattern: tự tin về -> về is about, preposition transfer
entries.context: I want to practice more, I am not confident about my English communication.

entries.vietlish: this product has good quality with reasonable price
entries.natural: this product has good quality at a reasonable price
entries.sourcePattern: chất lượng tốt với giá hợp lý -> with used for price instead of at
entries.context: I recommend it, this product has good quality with reasonable price.

entries.vietlish: I must improve my knowledge
entries.natural: I need to improve my skills
entries.sourcePattern: nâng cao kiến thức -> nâng cao knowledge, sometimes overspecified
entries.context: To get promoted I must improve my knowledge in this field.

entries.vietlish: her face is very beautiful
entries.natural: she is very beautiful
entries.sourcePattern: khuôn mặt cô ấy đẹp -> literal face beautiful construction
entries.context: I think you should meet her, her face is very beautiful.

entries.vietlish: I want a job with high salary
entries.natural: I want a high-paying job
entries.sourcePattern: công việc lương cao -> job with high salary literal compound
entries.context: After graduation I want a job with high salary in the finance sector.

entries.vietlish: he speak so that I can understand
entries.natural: he spoke slowly so that I could understand
entries.sourcePattern: nói chậm để tôi hiểu -> slowly dropped, past tense dropped
entries.context: He was very patient, he speak so that I can understand every word.

entries.vietlish: what you think about this idea
entries.natural: what do you think about this idea
entries.sourcePattern: bạn nghĩ gì về -> do-inversion dropped in question
entries.context: I just proposed a new plan, what you think about this idea?

entries.vietlish: how long you have lived here
entries.natural: how long have you lived here
entries.sourcePattern: bạn sống ở đây bao lâu -> question word order without inversion
entries.context: How long you have lived here? The neighbourhood looks familiar to you.

entries.vietlish: why she did not call me back
entries.natural: why did she not call me back
entries.sourcePattern: tại sao cô ấy không gọi lại -> why with SVO order, no inversion
entries.context: I waited all evening, why she did not call me back?

entries.vietlish: when you will come back to Saigon
entries.natural: when will you come back to Saigon
entries.sourcePattern: khi nào bạn sẽ về Sài Gòn -> when question without inversion
entries.context: I miss you, when you will come back to Saigon?

entries.vietlish: who is the person responsible for this
entries.natural: who is responsible for this
entries.sourcePattern: ai là người chịu trách nhiệm -> người is person, inserted literally
entries.context: There was a mistake in the report, who is the person responsible for this?

entries.vietlish: how much it costs to go there by taxi
entries.natural: how much does it cost to go there by taxi
entries.sourcePattern: bao nhiêu tiền đi taxi -> how much question without do-support
entries.context: I do not know the route, how much it costs to go there by taxi?

entries.vietlish: where I should park my car
entries.natural: where should I park my car
entries.sourcePattern: tôi nên đỗ xe ở đâu -> where with SVO, no inversion
entries.context: I have never been here before, where I should park my car?

entries.vietlish: which bus I should take to the airport
entries.natural: which bus should I take to the airport
entries.sourcePattern: tôi nên đi xe buýt số mấy -> which question without inversion
entries.context: I need to leave soon, which bus I should take to the airport?

entries.vietlish: I have a friend who she works at that hospital
entries.natural: I have a friend who works at that hospital
entries.sourcePattern: tôi có người bạn mà cô ấy làm -> resumptive pronoun she in relative clause
entries.context: Maybe she can help you, I have a friend who she works at that hospital.

entries.vietlish: the teacher who he taught me last year moved to Hanoi
entries.natural: the teacher who taught me last year moved to Hanoi
entries.sourcePattern: thầy giáo mà thầy dạy tôi -> resumptive he in relative clause
entries.context: The teacher who he taught me last year moved to Hanoi for a better position.

entries.vietlish: the boy that he sits next to me is very smart
entries.natural: the boy who sits next to me is very smart
entries.sourcePattern: thằng bé mà nó ngồi cạnh tôi -> resumptive he in relative clause
entries.context: The boy that he sits next to me is very smart and always helps me.

entries.vietlish: how much money you earn per month
entries.natural: how much do you earn per month
entries.sourcePattern: bạn kiếm bao nhiêu tiền một tháng -> question without inversion, money added
entries.context: If you don't mind me asking, how much money you earn per month?

entries.vietlish: do you know where is the post office
entries.natural: do you know where the post office is
entries.sourcePattern: bạn có biết bưu điện ở đâu không -> embedded question word order not shifted
entries.context: Excuse me, do you know where is the post office near here?

entries.vietlish: can you tell me how much is the ticket
entries.natural: can you tell me how much the ticket is
entries.sourcePattern: cho tôi biết vé bao nhiêu -> embedded question not inverted in reported speech
entries.context: Before I decide, can you tell me how much is the ticket to Da Lat?

entries.vietlish: I don't know why is she so quiet today
entries.natural: I don't know why she is so quiet today
entries.sourcePattern: tôi không biết tại sao cô ấy im lặng -> embedded why keeps inversion
entries.context: She looks upset, I don't know why is she so quiet today.

entries.vietlish: I want to confirm that when does the meeting start
entries.natural: I want to confirm when the meeting starts
entries.sourcePattern: muốn xác nhận cuộc họp bắt đầu lúc mấy giờ -> embedded question inverted
entries.context: Sorry to bother you, I want to confirm that when does the meeting start.

entries.vietlish: I wonder that is she coming tonight
entries.natural: I wonder if she is coming tonight
entries.sourcePattern: tôi tự hỏi liệu cô ấy có đến không -> wonder that + inverted question
entries.context: She has not replied to my message, I wonder that is she coming tonight.

entries.vietlish: please explain me how to use this machine
entries.natural: please explain to me how to use this machine
entries.sourcePattern: giải thích cho tôi -> explain requires to before indirect object in English
entries.context: I have never used it before, please explain me how to use this machine.

entries.vietlish: he described me in detail what happened
entries.natural: he described to me in detail what happened
entries.sourcePattern: mô tả cho tôi -> describe requires to before indirect object
entries.context: He described me in detail what happened at the meeting yesterday.

entries.vietlish: she suggested me to apply for that position
entries.natural: she suggested that I apply for that position
entries.sourcePattern: gợi ý tôi nên -> suggest does not take object + to-infinitive
entries.context: She suggested me to apply for that position because I have the right skills.

entries.vietlish: the bus full already
entries.natural: the bus is already full
entries.sourcePattern: xe buýt đầy rồi -> adjective predicate without copula, already at end
entries.context: We cannot get on, the bus full already, let us wait for the next one.

entries.vietlish: I will try my best to complete this task on time
entries.natural: I will try my best to complete this task on time
entries.sourcePattern: tôi sẽ cố gắng -> standard phrase, not erroneous but over-formal register mismatch
entries.context: I will try my best to complete this task on time, please trust me.

entries.vietlish: can I ask you a question about the price
entries.natural: may I ask you a question about the price
entries.sourcePattern: cho tôi hỏi -> can used where may is more polite in service contexts
entries.context: Excuse me sir, can I ask you a question about the price of this item?

entries.vietlish: I want to complain about this product
entries.natural: I would like to make a complaint about this product
entries.sourcePattern: tôi muốn khiếu nại -> I want replaces I would like in formal complaint context
entries.context: This product is broken when I opened it, I want to complain about this product.

entries.vietlish: is it okay if I go home early today
entries.natural: would it be all right if I left early today
entries.sourcePattern: tôi có thể về sớm không -> is it okay instead of would it be all right in workplace
entries.context: My child is sick, is it okay if I go home early today?

entries.vietlish: I think your suggestion not so good
entries.natural: I respectfully disagree with your suggestion
entries.sourcePattern: gợi ý của bạn không tốt lắm -> blunt negation instead of polite disagreement
entries.context: In the meeting he said I think your suggestion not so good in front of everyone.

entries.vietlish: give me the form
entries.natural: could I please have the form
entries.sourcePattern: đưa cho tôi tờ mẫu -> imperative give instead of polite request
entries.context: She walked up to the counter and said give me the form very loudly.

entries.vietlish: I want to cancel my appointment
entries.natural: I would like to reschedule my appointment
entries.sourcePattern: tôi muốn hủy -> cancel used where reschedule is intended and more appropriate
entries.context: I cannot make it on Thursday, I want to cancel my appointment.

entries.vietlish: your answer is wrong
entries.natural: I think there may be a small error in your answer
entries.sourcePattern: câu trả lời của bạn sai -> blunt statement instead of diplomatic correction
entries.context: In front of the class the student told the teacher your answer is wrong.

entries.vietlish: can you do faster
entries.natural: could you please work a bit more quickly
entries.sourcePattern: làm nhanh lên -> imperative-style request without please or modal softener
entries.context: She was frustrated and told the cashier can you do faster please.

entries.vietlish: I need you to come on time
entries.natural: I would appreciate it if you could come on time
entries.sourcePattern: tôi cần bạn đến đúng giờ -> I need too direct for polite request to equal
entries.context: In the work email she wrote I need you to come on time to the next meeting.

entries.vietlish: this is too expensive, reduce a bit
entries.natural: could you give me a small discount
entries.sourcePattern: đắt quá, bớt cho tôi -> reduce a bit is abrupt in formal retail register
entries.context: She pointed at the price tag and said this is too expensive, reduce a bit.

entries.vietlish: I do not know, ask someone else
entries.natural: I am sorry, I am not the right person to ask
entries.sourcePattern: tôi không biết, hỏi người khác -> abrupt dismissal in service context
entries.context: The customer asked for help and the staff replied I do not know, ask someone else.

entries.vietlish: the professor is not here right now
entries.natural: the professor is unavailable at the moment
entries.sourcePattern: giáo sư không ở đây -> informal phrase in formal academic context
entries.context: The student called and I said the professor is not here right now, can I take a message.

entries.vietlish: let me check for you
entries.natural: certainly, allow me to check that for you
entries.sourcePattern: để tôi kiểm tra -> let me is too casual for formal service encounter
entries.context: The customer asked about the delivery date and the agent replied let me check for you.

entries.vietlish: I will send you the file later
entries.natural: I will forward you the file shortly
entries.sourcePattern: tôi sẽ gửi file sau -> later is vague in formal professional context
entries.context: In the email reply he wrote I will send you the file later.

entries.vietlish: please sign your name here
entries.natural: please sign here
entries.sourcePattern: ký tên vào đây -> tên is name, added unnecessarily after sign
entries.context: The notary pointed to the bottom of the form and said please sign your name here.

entries.vietlish: I am very sad when leaving my homeland
entries.natural: I was very sad to leave my homeland
entries.sourcePattern: rất buồn khi rời quê hương -> when clause instead of to-infinitive, tense mismatch
entries.context: In her college essay she wrote I am very sad when leaving my homeland.

entries.vietlish: I hope you will satisfy with our service
entries.natural: I hope you are satisfied with our service
entries.sourcePattern: tôi hy vọng bạn hài lòng -> satisfy used intransitively, tense mismatch
entries.context: At the end of the call the agent said I hope you will satisfy with our service.

entries.vietlish: I need to go toilet
entries.natural: I need to use the restroom
entries.sourcePattern: đi vệ sinh -> go toilet, preposition to dropped, informal in formal register
entries.context: Excuse me for a moment, I need to go toilet.

entries.vietlish: do you have medicine for headache
entries.natural: do you have anything for a headache
entries.sourcePattern: có thuốc nhức đầu không -> direct noun compound without article
entries.context: I have been in the sun too long, do you have medicine for headache?

entries.vietlish: I got sore throat since this morning
entries.natural: I have had a sore throat since this morning
entries.sourcePattern: bị đau họng từ sáng -> got for have with ailments, present perfect dropped
entries.context: I got sore throat since this morning, can I see the doctor today?

entries.vietlish: my head very dizzy
entries.natural: I feel very dizzy
entries.sourcePattern: đầu tôi choáng váng -> head as subject for dizzy feeling, copula dropped
entries.context: I need to sit down, my head very dizzy after standing up.

entries.vietlish: take number and wait outside
entries.natural: please take a number and wait outside
entries.sourcePattern: lấy số thứ tự và chờ bên ngoài -> bare imperative without please
entries.context: The clerk just pointed and said take number and wait outside.

entries.vietlish: I will check again and reply you
entries.natural: I will check again and get back to you
entries.sourcePattern: trả lời bạn -> reply you without preposition to in professional email
entries.context: Thank you for your email, I will check again and reply you soon.

entries.vietlish: kindly revert back to me at your earliest
entries.natural: please let me know at your earliest convenience
entries.sourcePattern: kindly revert -> over-formal Indian-English influenced phrase common in Vietnamese office writing
entries.context: In the email she wrote kindly revert back to me at your earliest.

entries.vietlish: I want to make an appointment to see the doctor
entries.natural: I would like to make an appointment to see the doctor
entries.sourcePattern: muốn đặt lịch -> I want instead of I would like in formal healthcare request
entries.context: She called the clinic and said I want to make an appointment to see the doctor.

entries.vietlish: I feel like crying out loud
entries.natural: I feel like crying
entries.sourcePattern: muốn khóc thét lên -> thét lên is out loud, carried over literally
entries.context: The news was so sad, I feel like crying out loud.

entries.vietlish: she is white like snow
entries.natural: she has very fair skin
entries.sourcePattern: trắng như tuyết -> direct simile calque for skin complexion description
entries.context: People always compliment her, she is white like snow.

entries.vietlish: he swallow the anger
entries.natural: he swallowed his anger
entries.sourcePattern: nuốt giận -> nuốt is swallow, giận is anger, direct calque
entries.context: He was insulted but he swallow the anger and stayed professional.

entries.vietlish: my heart is very tight right now
entries.natural: my heart feels heavy right now
entries.sourcePattern: lòng tôi thắt lại -> tight heart for sadness/anxiety, direct calque
entries.context: I miss my family so much, my heart is very tight right now.

entries.vietlish: she put her whole heart into this project
entries.natural: she put her heart and soul into this project
entries.sourcePattern: dốc hết tâm sức -> whole heart calque for dedication
entries.context: She put her whole heart into this project and it showed in the result.

entries.vietlish: I carry money not enough
entries.natural: I did not bring enough money
entries.sourcePattern: mang tiền không đủ -> carry money negative + bare adjective, verb tense dropped
entries.context: I have to go back to get more, I carry money not enough today.

entries.vietlish: he is a person with a lot of experience
entries.natural: he is very experienced
entries.sourcePattern: người có nhiều kinh nghiệm -> full NP calque where adjective is standard
entries.context: You should follow his advice, he is a person with a lot of experience.

entries.vietlish: this is a thing that everyone knows
entries.natural: this is common knowledge
entries.sourcePattern: điều mà ai cũng biết -> full relative clause calque for idiomatic phrase
entries.context: There is no need to explain, this is a thing that everyone knows.

entries.vietlish: I open my eyes big to look at the screen
entries.natural: I opened my eyes wide to look at the screen
entries.sourcePattern: mở to mắt ra -> open big eyes, big/wide confusion in calque
entries.context: It was so interesting, I open my eyes big to look at the screen.

entries.vietlish: he has a warm mouth
entries.natural: he is a smooth talker
entries.sourcePattern: miệng ngọt -> sweet/warm mouth for flattery, direct calque
entries.context: Be careful with him, he has a warm mouth and always gets what he wants.

entries.vietlish: she has a long tongue
entries.natural: she talks too much
entries.sourcePattern: miệng dài -> long tongue/mouth for gossiping, direct calque
entries.context: Do not tell her any secrets, she has a long tongue.

entries.vietlish: step by step and then we will win
entries.natural: one step at a time and we will get there
entries.sourcePattern: từng bước một rồi sẽ thắng -> step by step calque with direct win
entries.context: Do not be discouraged, step by step and then we will win.

entries.vietlish: she is under a lot of stress lately
entries.natural: she has been under a lot of stress lately
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy đang chịu nhiều áp lực -> simple present for present perfect progressive
entries.context: She looks exhausted, she is under a lot of stress lately.

entries.vietlish: I want to become close friend with her
entries.natural: I want to become close friends with her
entries.sourcePattern: muốn kết thân với cô ấy -> close friend singular instead of close friends
entries.context: She seems like a nice person, I want to become close friend with her.
